CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_spend_overview()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_cfg ai_spend_limits;
  v_month date;
  v_day date;
  v_rank integer := ai_role_rank(auth.uid());
begin
  if v_rank < 2 then
    raise exception 'ai_spend_overview: supervisor or above only';
  end if;

  select * into v_cfg from ai_spend_limits where id = 1;
  v_month := date_trunc('month', (now() at time zone coalesce(v_cfg.timezone, 'UTC')))::date;
  v_day := (now() at time zone coalesce(v_cfg.timezone, 'UTC'))::date;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'can_edit', v_rank >= 3,
    'limits', jsonb_build_object(
      'per_user_daily_calls', v_cfg.per_user_daily_calls,
      'monthly_cap_cents', v_cfg.monthly_cap_cents,
      'content_multiplier', v_cfg.content_multiplier,
      'min_role', v_cfg.min_role,
      'alert_at_pct', v_cfg.alert_at_pct,
      'enforced', v_cfg.enforced,
      'timezone', v_cfg.timezone,
      'updated_at', v_cfg.updated_at
    ),
    'month', jsonb_build_object(
      'usage_month', v_month,
      'calls', coalesce((select calls from ai_spend_months where usage_month = v_month), 0),
      'spent_micros', coalesce((select spent_micros from ai_spend_months where usage_month = v_month), 0),
      'reserved_micros', coalesce((select reserved_micros from ai_spend_months where usage_month = v_month), 0),
      'cap_micros', v_cfg.monthly_cap_cents::bigint * 10000
    ),
    'people', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(row_to_json(t))
      from (
        select
          e.user_id,
          coalesce(p.display_name, 'Removed user') as display_name,
          coalesce(p.role, 'unknown') as role,
          count(*) filter (where e.outcome = 'allowed') as calls,
          coalesce(sum(e.cost_micros), 0) as cost_micros,
          count(*) filter (where e.outcome like 'denied%') as blocked,
          coalesce((
            select d.calls from ai_usage_days d
             where d.user_id = e.user_id and d.usage_day = v_day
          ), 0) as calls_today
        from ai_usage_events e
        left join profiles p on p.id = e.user_id
        where e.usage_month = v_month
        group by e.user_id, p.display_name, p.role
        order by coalesce(sum(e.cost_micros), 0) desc,
                 count(*) filter (where e.outcome = 'allowed') desc
        limit 25
      ) t
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'functions', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(row_to_json(f))
      from (
        select function_name,
               count(*) filter (where outcome = 'allowed') as calls,
               coalesce(sum(cost_micros), 0) as cost_micros
          from ai_usage_events
         where usage_month = v_month
         group by function_name
         order by coalesce(sum(cost_micros), 0) desc
      ) f
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'alerts', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(row_to_json(a))
      from (
        select level, reserved_micros, cap_micros, created_at
          from ai_spend_alerts
         where usage_month = v_month
         order by created_at desc
      ) a
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  );
end;
$function$
functions.name: ai_spend_overview

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_spend_release(p_event_id uuid, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_refund_call boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_event ai_usage_events;
begin
  select * into v_event from ai_usage_events
   where id = p_event_id and outcome = 'allowed' and settled_at is null
   for update;
  if not found then return; end if;

  update ai_usage_events
     set outcome = 'released',
         release_reason = p_reason,
         cost_micros = 0,
         settled_at = now()
   where id = p_event_id;

  update ai_spend_months
     set reserved_micros = greatest(0, reserved_micros - v_event.estimate_micros),
         calls = case when p_refund_call then greatest(0, calls - 1) else calls end,
         updated_at = now()
   where usage_month = v_event.usage_month;

  if p_refund_call and v_event.user_id is not null then
    update ai_usage_days
       set calls = greatest(0, calls - 1), updated_at = now()
     where user_id = v_event.user_id and usage_day = v_event.usage_day;
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ai_spend_set_limits(p_per_user_daily_calls integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_monthly_cap_cents integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_min_role text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_enforced boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_tz text;
begin
  if ai_role_rank(auth.uid()) < 3 then
    raise exception 'ai_spend_set_limits: owner only';
  end if;
  if p_min_role is not null
     and p_min_role not in ('installer', 'foreman', 'supervisor', 'owner') then
    raise exception 'ai_spend_set_limits: unknown role %', p_min_role;
  end if;

  update ai_spend_limits
     set per_user_daily_calls =
           coalesce(greatest(0, p_per_user_daily_calls), per_user_daily_calls),
         monthly_cap_cents =
           coalesce(greatest(0, p_monthly_cap_cents), monthly_cap_cents),
         min_role = coalesce(p_min_role, min_role),
         enforced = coalesce(p_enforced, enforced),
         updated_at = now(),
         updated_by = auth.uid()
   where id = 1;

  -- Raising the ceiling must clear the block immediately, so the 'cap' alert
  -- for this month is retired and can fire again if the new ceiling is reached.
  select timezone into v_tz from ai_spend_limits where id = 1;
  delete from ai_spend_alerts
   where level = 'cap'
     and usage_month = date_trunc('month', (now() at time zone coalesce(v_tz, 'UTC')))::date
     and cap_micros < (select monthly_cap_cents::bigint * 10000 from ai_spend_limits where id = 1);

  return public.ai_spend_overview();
end;
$function$
functions.name: ai_spend_set_limits

declare

     set input_tokens = p_input_tokens,
         output_tokens = p_output_tokens,
         cost_micros = v_actual,
         model = coalesce(p_model, model),
         settled_at = now()
   where id = p_event_id;

  -- Swap the reservation for the real figure, and add the real figure to the
  -- running truth.
  update ai_spend_months
     set reserved_micros =
           greatest(0, reserved_micros - v_event.estimate_micros + v_actual),
         spent_micros = spent_micros + v_actual,
         updated_at = now()
   where usage_month = v_event.usage_month;

  if v_event.user_id is not null then
    update ai_usage_days
       set cost_micros = cost_micros + v_actual, updated_at = now()
     where user_id = v_event.user_id and usage_day = v_event.usage_day;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_staging_bays(p_job_code text)
 RETURNS SETOF locations
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_code text := btrim(coalesce(p_job_code, ''));
begin
  -- A job code of '' would generate the address 'J--A', which is not a shelf
  -- anyone can label or find. Better to create nothing and let the detection
  -- check and suggest_location()'s refusal make the gap loud.
  if v_code = '' then
    return;
  end if;

  -- Bring back a bay that was retired rather than leaving the job one short.
  -- Retiring is how the app deletes a slot (deleteLocation sets active=false),
  -- so without this the repair path would have no way to undo one.
  update public.locations
     set active = true
   where zone = 'J' and rack = v_code and slot in ('A', 'B') and not active;

  -- `where not exists` rather than relying on ON CONFLICT alone: locations.serial
  -- defaults to nextval('location_serial_seq'), sequences are not transactional,
  -- and ON CONFLICT evaluates the default before it discovers the conflict. So a
  -- bare ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING would burn two permanent serials every time this
  -- ran against a job that already had its bays — and this runs on every project
  -- insert and every repair click. ON CONFLICT stays as the race backstop only.
  --
  -- serial is never named here, exactly as createProject never named it and the
  -- seed migration never named it: the column default is the only allocator, and
  -- the six live bays hold SLOT-000039..000052 with gaps in them. Nothing
  -- requires serials to be contiguous. `address` is never named either — it is a
  -- generated column and Postgres rejects an INSERT that mentions it.
  insert into public.locations (zone, rack, slot, capacity)
  select 'J', v_code, s.slot, 10
    from (values ('A'), ('B')) as s(slot)
   where not exists (
     select 1 from public.locations l
      where l.zone = 'J' and l.rack = v_code and l.slot = s.slot
   )
  on conflict (zone, rack, slot) do nothing;

  return query
    select l.* from public.locations l
     where l.zone = 'J' and l.rack = v_code
     order by l.slot;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_reorder_needs(p_project_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(window_type_id uuid, type_name text, missing_count integer, damaged_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare v_role text;
begin
  select role into v_role from profiles where id = auth.uid();
  if v_role is null or v_role = 'installer' then
    raise exception 'only a foreman-level user or above can view reorder needs';
  end if;

  return query
  with damaged as (
    select w.window_type_id as tid, count(*)::int as cnt
    from windows w
    where w.project_id = p_project_id and w.status = 'damaged'
    group by w.window_type_id
  ),
  missing as (
    select w.window_type_id as tid, count(*)::int as cnt
    from issues i
    join windows w on w.id = i.window_id
    where i.project_id = p_project_id
      and i.kind = 'missing'
      and i.status = 'open'
    group by w.window_type_id
  ),
  tids as (
    select tid from damaged
    union
    select tid from missing
  )
  select
    t.tid,
    wt.name,
    coalesce(m.cnt, 0),
    coalesce(d.cnt, 0)
  from tids t
  join window_types wt on wt.id = t.tid
  left join missing m on m.tid = t.tid
  left join damaged d on d.tid = t.tid
  order by wt.type_code;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_knowledge_chunks(query_embedding vector, match_count integer DEFAULT 8, min_similarity double precision DEFAULT 0.0)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, doc_id uuid, title text, path text, content text, chunk_index integer, similarity double precision)

  select

    d.path,
    c.content,

 RETURNS void

 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  delete from project_windows pw
  where pw.project_id = p_project_id
    and not exists (
      select 1
      from project_openings o
      where o.project_id = p_project_id
        and o.confirmed = true
        and o.window_type_id = pw.window_type_id
    );

  insert into project_windows (project_id, window_type_id, quantity)
  select
    p_project_id,
    o.window_type_id,
    count(*)::int
  from project_openings o
  where o.project_id = p_project_id
    and o.confirmed = true
    and o.window_type_id is not null
  group by o.window_type_id
  on conflict (project_id, window_type_id)
  do update set quantity = excluded.quantity;
end;

views.definition:
SELECT e.installer_id,
    t.category,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.minutes IS NOT NULL)) AS n,
    percentile_cont((0.5)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((e.minutes)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (e.minutes IS NOT NULL)) AS median_minutes,
    avg(e.quality_grade) FILTER (WHERE (e.quality_grade IS NOT NULL)) AS avg_grade
   FROM (install_events e
     JOIN window_types t ON ((t.id = e.window_type_id)))
  WHERE ((e.installer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (t.category IS NOT NULL))
  GROUP BY e.installer_id, t.category;
views.name: installer_category_stats

views.definition:
SELECT e.installer_id,
    e.window_type_id,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.minutes IS NOT NULL)) AS n,
    percentile_cont((0.5)::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ((e.minutes)::double precision)) FILTER (WHERE (e.minutes IS NOT NULL)) AS median_minutes,
    avg(e.quality_grade) FILTER (WHERE (e.quality_grade IS NOT NULL)) AS avg_grade,
    ((count(DISTINCT e.id) FILTER (WHERE ((e.quality_grade <= 2) OR (q.status = 'callback'::text))))::numeric / (NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric) AS fail_rate,
    max(e.created_at) AS last_at
   FROM (install_events e
     LEFT JOIN qc_checks q ON ((q.project_opening_id = e.project_opening_id)))
  WHERE ((e.installer_id IS NOT NULL) AND (e.window_type_id IS NOT NULL))
  GROUP BY e.installer_id, e.window_type_id;
views.name: installer_type_stats

safety_talks.body: Before any work above 6 ft: inspect the ladder/lift, tie off, and clear the drop zone below. Nobody works overhead without a spotter.
safety_talks.title: Elevated work check

howto_json.detail: Measure width at 3 points and height at 2; confirm the unit fits with 1/4-1/2" shim clearance before carrying it up.
howto_json.title: Dry-fit and check the rough opening

howto_json.detail: Last installs cammed out upper hinge screws — pre-drill to avoid it.
howto_json.title: Pre-drill the hinge side

howto_json.detail: Set it just outside before the lift; two-person set keeps the cladding clean.
howto_json.title: Stage the unit outside the opening

howto_json.detail: Plastic shims with an impact on clutch; check square with a diagonal tape before fastening.
howto_json.title: Shim and level

howto_json.detail: Flashing tape on the first pass; foam-seal clean. Watch fingers on tempered edges.
howto_json.title: Flash and seal

window_types.name: Casement 30x50
tips_json: Pre-check RO with diagonal tape before setting the unit
Stage the unit outside the opening before the lift
Use impact with clutch + plastic shims on casement hinges
Bring a Japanese pull saw when the RO is racked
Call out pinch points on the swing path
watch_outs_json: Upper hinge screws can cam out on casements
Out-of-square RO by 3/8" will blow the time estimate
Tempered edges — watch fingers

howto_json.detail: Width at 3 points, height at 2, both diagonals. A double-hung binds fast if the sill is not level — fix the opening, never force the frame.
howto_json.title: Verify the rough opening

howto_json.detail: Shim at the setting points only, snug not tight. The sill is where a hung window lives or dies.
howto_json.title: Set the sill dead level

howto_json.detail: Even reveal on all four sides before fastening. A tapered reveal tells you which corner is off.
howto_json.title: Set and check reveal

howto_json.detail: One over-driven screw racks the frame and drops the sashes. Check diagonals after each side.
howto_json.title: Fasten per schedule, re-check square

howto_json.detail: Laps shed downhill. Low-expansion foam in passes so the jambs do not bow and jam the balances.
howto_json.title: Flash jambs then head, foam light

window_types.name: Hopper 30x24
tips_json: Hopper opens inward at the top - confirm swing clearance inside before setting.
Drain side out; flash sides first, top flashing last over the flange lip.
Level first - a racked hopper will not seal at the sill.
Caulk flanges left/right/top, leave the bottom to drain.
Test the latch and full open/close before final caulk.
watch_outs_json: Common in basements/wells - verify the well drains so the unit does not sit in water.
Confirm setout depth (stucco vs rock).
Do not seal the bottom weep holes.

window_types.name: Double-Hung 32x52
tips_json: Drain slots on the bottom face OUT - confirm before lifting it in.
Flash the sides first, top flashing last over the flange lip.
Caulk flanges left/right/top, never the bottom - the bottom has to drain.
Level first, then center. Set the flange screws, then remove the shims.
Check both sashes slide before you screw off - a racked frame binds a double-hung fast.
watch_outs_json: Do not seal the bottom weep holes - a double-hung will pond water if you do.
Confirm stucco vs rock setout before install.
On hot days ease off screw torque on vinyl frames.

window_types.name: Slider 72x48
tips_json: Large slider - plan a 2-person lift with the suction machine; never solo it.
Level and square are everything - test-roll the panels before you commit screws.
Drain out; flash the sides, then top flashing last over the flange.
Shim to level, set flange screws, pull shims, re-check the roll.
Caulk flanges left/right/top only; leave the bottom open.
watch_outs_json: Heavy glass - keep everyone clear of the drop zone and the suction path.
A slightly racked large slider will not seal or roll - do not accept it.
Confirm the suction-cup machine is on site before scheduling this unit.

window_types.name: Picture 48x48
tips_json: Stationary unit - no moving parts, so the finish caulk is the whole quality story.
Drain side out; flash sides first, top flashing last over the flange lip.
Level and center - with no sash to hide it, an out-of-level picture window shows.
Exterior finish caulk is permanent: tape a ~3/4 in gap, caulk, then tool one smooth line.
Photograph the finished caulk line and that all tape/stickers are removed.
watch_outs_json: Sloppy tooling on the exterior caulk is the most common callback on picture windows.
Confirm setout depth (stucco vs rock).
Big glass = 2-person lift; keep clear of the drop zone.

window_types.name: Awning 30x24
tips_json: Drain side out; flash sides first, top flashing last over the flange.
Level matters - an awning that is off will not seal against the frame when cranked shut.
Caulk flanges left/right/top only; leave the bottom to drain.
Set flange screws after leveling, pull shims, then crank through full travel.
Confirm the arm hardware operates smoothly before final caulk.
watch_outs_json: An out-of-level awning leaks at the hinge side - level carefully.
Confirm setout depth up front.
Do not force vinyl on hot days.

window_types.name: Picture 60x48
tips_json: Stationary - the exterior caulk finish is the whole job quality; take your time tooling it.
2-person lift; set the bottom in, tilt up, drain side facing out.
Flash sides first, top flashing last over the flange lip.
Level and center; caulk flanges left/right/top, leave the bottom to drain.
Photograph the final caulk line and confirm tape/stickers removed.
watch_outs_json: Tooling quality varies by installer - a bumpy caulk line is a visible defect.
Confirm stucco vs rock setout.
Keep clear of suspended glass during the lift.

window_types.name: Slider 60x48
tips_json: This is a 2-person lift - use suction cups or straps. Set the bottom into the frame, then tilt up.
Get it dead level before screwing off or the panels will not roll smoothly.
Drain side out; flash sides first, top flashing last over the flange lip.
Caulk flanges left/right/top, leave the bottom to drain.
Roll both panels full travel before final caulk to confirm no bind.
watch_outs_json: A racked slider binds - level and square matter more here than on a small window.
Never get under a suspended panel during the lift.
Confirm stucco vs rock setout before setting depth.

window_types.name: Single-Hung 32x52
tips_json: Find the drain slots on the bottom of the frame - that side faces OUT. Never set it drain-side in.
Flash both sides before you set the window; roll the TOP flashing last, over the flange lip, so water sheds down.
Caulk the flanges left, right and top only - leave the bottom open so trapped water can drain.
Shim and level first, center second. Level always wins. Set screws through the flanges, then pull the shims.
St. George standard: caulk off the top and side weep holes, leave the bottom drains open.
watch_outs_json: Out-of-level wall: shim to true level even if the reveal looks uneven - flag the foreman if it is more than ~1 in off.
Confirm stucco vs rock before setting depth - it changes the setout ~1 in (rock) vs ~1.5 in (stucco).
Vinyl softens in high heat - do not overdrive screws or force a bind on hot days.

window_types.name: Casement 30x48
tips_json: Drain side faces OUT. Flash sides before setting, top flashing last over the flange.
Level is critical on a casement - if it is out, the sash will not seal or will swing on its own.
Caulk flanges left/right/top only; leave the bottom for drainage.
Set screws through the flange after leveling, then pull the shims and check the sash swings clean.
Test the crank through full travel before you finish caulk.
watch_outs_json: A casement that is not dead level will not latch - do not rush the level step.
Confirm setout depth (stucco vs rock) up front.
Watch the sash edge for scratches when unpackaging with a utility knife.

howto_json.detail: A large picture unit is heavy and often tempered/laminated. Check the etched bug and recalc crew/lift gear before it comes up.
howto_json.title: Confirm glass spec and safety bug

howto_json.detail: Set on edge, never flat — a fixed lite this size will pop its IGU seal if racked during handling.
howto_json.title: Dry-fit and stage on A-frames

howto_json.detail: Setting blocks at the quarter points carry the weight. Center the unit so the perimeter joint is uniform for backer rod.
howto_json.title: Set on blocks, center the reveal

howto_json.detail: Fixed units still rack. Fasten progressively and keep diagonals equal; a racked picture unit shows as a wavy reflection.
howto_json.title: Anchor without racking

howto_json.detail: Rod to half the joint width, tool the same day. Big lites move a lot thermally — the joint must stretch, not shear.
howto_json.title: Backer rod + tooled sealant

window_types.name: Bay 72x48
tips_json: Bay is a structural, 3-person unit - it needs support below and cable/knee bracing above per plan.
Confirm the head board and support brackets are in before you hang any weight.
Flash the full perimeter carefully; the roof/seat connections are the leak risk, not just the flanges.
Level and center the center lite first, then bring the flankers to it.
Seal the seat and roof junctions and photograph every flashing/caulk joint.
watch_outs_json: Bays fail from under-support and roof-junction leaks - never skip the bracing or seat flashing.
3-person job with heavy glass - stage the lift and keep the drop zone clear.
Confirm the opening framing and setout with the foreman before starting - bays are non-starters if the rough opening is wrong.
